synthesis:draft.headline: SA1 five‑minute RRP peak $845.00/MWh at 2026-07-29 17:25 ACST (interval end 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z).
summary: The five‑minute regional reference price (RRP) peak in the window was $845.00/MWh at interval-ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z (2026-07-29 17:25 ACST).
That price is a single five‑minute episode (n_intervals = 1) in the high‑price episodes returned for the window.
There were 26 five‑minute intervals at-or-above the $300.00/MWh analysis threshold in the window.
Dispatch TOTALDEMAND at interval-ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z (the 5‑minute peak) was 1964.83 MW.
Net interchange at interval-ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z was -162.76 MW (net flow into SA1).
Operational half‑hour demand for the half‑hour ending 2026-07-29T08:00:00Z was 1872.0 MW; the public POE50 forecast for that same half‑hour was 2042.0 MW.
AEMO published forecast Lack Of Reserve notices for 29 July 2026 (examples listed under published_findings).

Market notice timing (from the notices' clock_times): the cancellation notice titled 'STPASA - Cancellation of the Forecast Lack Of Reserve Level 2 (LOR2) in the SA Region on 29/07/2026' gives 2026-07-27 11:30 ACST (2026-07-27T02:00:00Z), before the first 5‑minute interval at or above the analysis threshold (interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z = 2026-07-29 17:25 ACST).

Market notice timing: the notice titled 'STPASA - Forecast Lack Of Reserve Level 2 (LOR2) in the SA Region on 29/07/2026' lists 2026-07-29 10:00 ACST (2026-07-29T00:30:00Z) and 2026-07-29 11:30 ACST (2026-07-29T02:00:00Z), both before the interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z (2026-07-29 17:25 ACST).

Market notice timing: the notice titled 'STPASA - Forecast Lack Of Reserve Level 2 (LOR2) in the SA Region on 29/07/2026' lists 2026-07-29 15:30 ACST (2026-07-29T06:00:00Z) and 2026-07-29 16:00 ACST (2026-07-29T06:30:00Z), both before the interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z (2026-07-29 17:25 ACST).

Market notice timing: the notice titled 'PDPASA - Forecast Lack Of Reserve Level 1 (LOR1) in the SA Region on 29/07/2026' lists 2026-07-29 06:30 ACST (2026-07-28T21:00:00Z), 2026-07-29 11:30 ACST (2026-07-29T02:00:00Z) and 2026-07-29 16:30 ACST (2026-07-29T07:00:00Z), all before the interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z (2026-07-29 17:25 ACST); it also lists 2026-07-29 22:00 ACST (2026-07-29T12:30:00Z), which is after that interval.

Market notice timing: the cancellation notice titled 'STPASA - Cancellation of the Forecast Lack Of Reserve Level 2 (LOR2) in the SA Region on 29/07/2026' gives 2026-07-27 08:50 ACST (2026-07-26T23:20:00Z), before the interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z (2026-07-29 17:25 ACST).

Market notice timing: the cancellation notice titled 'PDPASA - Cancellation of the Forecast Lack Of Reserve Level 1 (LOR1) in the SA Region on 29/07/2026' gives 2026-07-28 13:15 ACST (2026-07-28T03:45:00Z), before the interval ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z (2026-07-29 17:25 ACST).

Taken together: AEMO published forecast LOR notices for 29 July and also published cancellations of some LOR forecasts prior to the date; those notices and their times are listed above and under published_findings.

possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Obtain rebid/offer logs and the dispatch marginal-unit record for interval-ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z to identify which DUID(s) cleared and their offered prices.

possible_explanations.statement: Prior AEMO Forecast LOR notices (for example the STPASA LOR2 notice quoted under published_findings) could have influenced participants' offers or availability before interval-ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare timestamps of rebids/offers with the notices' publication times and check whether offer patterns changed after the notices but before interval-ending 2026-07-29T07:55:00Z.
